creativeThesis: A real-looking leaf carries a recent event inside a temporary chemical state; timing makes the same stimulus end in visibly different plant responses.
viewerExperience: See a living hair move → realize an internal signal occurred → follow a lingering calcium state → compare another signal before and after decay → distinguish signals from touch count → understand biochemical memory.
emotionalTarget: Living wonder followed by an intuitive, scientifically qualified understanding of temporal information.
visualThesis: Travel from natural botanical context to one hair and a curved leaf. Brief electrical events and retained chemistry stay spatially separate yet continuous; matched outcomes are dimensional closed versus open forms, then a real-plant return.

decisions.treatment: Original textured3D botanical reconstruction with an inspected CC0 actual-plant photo at beginning/end. Burri S2 supports pivot motion consultation only.
decisions.rationale: Control hair contact, retained state and two outcomes in one spatial object; documentary anchor restores biological reality.
alternativesConsidered: Documentary footage as the principal mechanism
New generated macro stills with motion

decisions.rationale: Intimate views reveal the physical stimulus; a surface-linked qualitative field carries information while silhouette proves the response.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest available exact approved/locked masters by recorded decision time: DiceV4,DevilsHoleV2,FLIPV1,VermeerV2. No popularity/publication/domain filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: A nature-science microstory moves from observed organism into invisible retained information and returns to the organism.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: No reuse of V1 cell renderer or planar hinge; compare primary footage, generated stills and controlled3D before selecting.

ownerReview.rationale: Explicit owner V2 revision authority, unchanged narration/claims and established local tools; exact replacement Master V2 Review required.

risks: Reconstruction is not filmed biology or calibrated morphology/biomechanics.
Intracellular calcium color is explicitly illustrative; no cell map, numerical concentration, fixed timer or universal closure threshold.
Hair lever pivots at base; selected bend-and-return and electrical examples are conditional, not every-touch rules.
Actual photo is botanical context, not the same experimentally stimulated specimen.
No subjective continuous playback/listening or actual-device/native crop evidence.

provenance.notes: Exact owner feedback, V1 failure analysis, prior master corrections, inspected licensed primary movie/photo, meaningful alternatives and actual recent visual samples. No publication or workflow-model envelope authority inferred.
